heroHeadline: Sisi Joins Trump-Arab Leaders Iran Call; New Delta EGP 800bn Megaproject Opens; Largest Western Desert Gas Find in 15 Years
heroSubtitle: Egypt escalated its regional diplomatic role this week: President Sisi joined a multilateral call with Trump and Arab leaders urging a 'diplomatic window' to conclude Iran nuclear negotiations, while FM Abdelatty contacted Iranian FM Araghchi and coordinated with Qatar, Algeria, and Tunisia. Domestically, Sisi inaugurated the EGP 800 billion New Delta agricultural megaproject expanding Egypt's cultivated land by over 20%, and Agiba/Eni announced the largest Western Desert gas discovery in 15 years (~330 bcf). The Central Bank held rates at 19%/20% but raised its 2026 inflation forecast to 16–17%, and an IMF seventh review mission arrived to potentially unlock ~$1.7 billion in new EFF financing.
footerNote: Data sourced from Egyptian official records, UNESCO, academic Egyptology research (Shaw, Lehner, Hawass), major international outlets, IMF, Human Rights Watch, and institutional analyses.
